replacement_mode.meaning: Replace the previous SUPERVISOR_RECOVERY_HANDOVER governing DIR-021. This replaces the previous recovery protocol only. It does not replace the executing developer, project specification, repository, verified implementation, or DIR-021 itself.

directive.title: Omnipresent ⌘K AI Career Copilot & Universal Command Surface 10/10 Overhaul (Context-Aware Prompts, Quick Actions & Multi-Model Execution)
directive.objective: Autonomously recover, supervise, verify, correct, re-plan, and continue DIR-021 to objectively verified completion while preserving all verified work and protected invariants.

supervisor_mandate.responsibility: Take responsibility for recovery and continuation rather than merely reporting a stalled state.
must: continue until a valid terminal state is reached
principles: Minimum safe intervention over broad rewrites.

do_not_wait_for_human_approval_for: localized non-destructive corrections within granted authority
human_approval_required_for: irreversible destructive actions without existing authorization
autonomous_execution.capability_rule: If a required capability is unavailable, never fabricate execution or evidence. Classify the limitation as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

recovery_trigger.meaning: 300 seconds without verified activity triggers investigation, not automatic interruption or restart.

adaptive_timeout.principle: The initial 300-second threshold is universal, but the supervisor must account for the expected runtime of the currently identified operation before declaring a legitimate long-running operation stalled.

unit_or_integration_tests.rule: Use observed historical or current runtime when available.

playwright_or_browser_suite.rule: Do not interrupt while browser processes, test workers, trace generation, or test output demonstrate legitimate activity.

large_build_or_bundle.rule: Continue observation while build processes remain alive and resource/output evidence indicates progress.

dependency_installation.rule: Do not interrupt while the package manager remains active and network, filesystem, or process evidence indicates progress.

database_migration.rule: Do not interrupt while the migration process remains active and database/process evidence indicates progress.

crawler_or_large_data_operation.rule: Use observed throughput, process activity, file activity, network activity, or task progress where available.

adaptive_timeout.dynamic_rule: If operation-specific evidence demonstrates that the operation is legitimately progressing, extend observation rather than declaring a stall solely because 300 seconds elapsed.

classifications.ALIVE_BUT_SILENT: The operation remains alive but has produced no recent visible output.
classifications.STALLED: The operation remains alive or expected to remain alive but objective evidence shows no meaningful progress beyond the operation's justified observation window.
classifications.FAILED: The operation exited, errored, or produced objective failure evidence.
classifications.UNKNOWN: Available evidence is insufficient to classify the operation.

verified_progress_rule.rule: Preserve all verified work already present on disk.

allowed_only_when: objective evidence identifies the current unverified change as the source of failure

if_resolved.record: resolved full 40-character SHA in recovery status

INV-1.name: Frozen Baseline Integrity
INV-1.required_condition: git diff <FULL_BASELINE_SHA> -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js produces exactly 0 bytes.

verification.pass_condition: Successful command with exactly empty stdout.

method: search sensitive-value propagation into URL/query construction
inspect telemetry and analytics payload construction
static.rule: Use verified repository-native tools or generic search/static-analysis tooling. Never invent nonexistent project scripts.

runtime.pass_condition: No protected data is exposed through forbidden channels.

INV-3.name: Quota And Rate Limit Gating
INV-3.requirement: Command-palette AI requests must strictly consume the authenticated user's authoritative MariaDB-backed daily AI quota.

discovery_state_machine.state_1: Locate command-palette AI request entry point.
discovery_state_machine.state_3: Locate authoritative quota service or repository.
discovery_state_machine.state_4: Locate authoritative MariaDB model/table through actual code.
discovery_state_machine.state_5: Locate quota consumption transaction or service contract.
discovery_state_machine.state_7: Trace failure behavior when quota state cannot be established.
discovery_state_machine.state_8: Verify client-side state cannot bypass backend enforcement.

required_behavior: consume quota according to existing authoritative semantics
fail closed when quota cannot safely be established
INV-3.status_rule: INV-3 remains NOT_YET_VERIFIED until the authoritative implementation contract is discovered and the verification matrix passes.

INV-4.name: WCAG Accessibility
INV-4.legacy_requirement: The original WCAG 2.1 AA requirement must remain satisfied.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Normal text contrast at least 4.5:1; applicable large text requirements must also be satisfied.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: User interface components and meaningful graphical objects must meet applicable non-text contrast requirements.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Keyboard
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: All command-palette functionality must be operable by keyboard.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Focus must not become trapped without an available keyboard exit.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Focus Visible
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Keyboard focus must be visibly identifiable.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Focused controls must not be obscured by the interface.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Target Size Minimum
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Applicable interactive targets must satisfy the WCAG 2.2 AA target-size requirement.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: On Focus
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Focus must not unexpectedly trigger disruptive context changes.

command_palette_applicable_criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
command_palette_applicable_criteria.requirement: Interactive command-palette controls must expose correct accessible semantics.

verification.pass_condition: All enumerated applicable criteria are satisfied and no regression against the original WCAG 2.1 AA requirement is demonstrated.

INV-5.name: Performance Budget

measurement_profile.browser: Chromium-based browser available in the project verification environment
measurement_profile.cpu_throttling: NONE unless a project-defined performance profile already exists
measurement_profile.network: LOCAL_OR_CONTROLLED; network latency must not contaminate local palette interaction measurements

measurement_methods: browser performance tooling where automation is unavailable
INV-5.pass_condition: Median observed latency satisfies the defined budget and p95 must not reveal a material systemic regression. Any failure must be reported with measured values and environment.

developer_instruction_contract.restart_instruction_prohibited: Do not instruct the developer to restart verified work unless objective evidence proves the existing work is unrecoverable.

evidence_policy.stale_evidence_rule: Evidence collected before a corrective modification cannot alone prove the corrected state.

repeated_failure_protocol.trigger: Same diagnosis remains unchanged after repeated attempts.

levels.1: Developer stalled. Issue corrective instruction and continue observation.
levels.2: Repeated unchanged failure. Stop current approach and re-plan.
levels.3: External dependency, unavailable tool, credential, or permission. Mark BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
levels.4: Protected invariant violation or unsafe state requiring authority beyond current scope. Preserve evidence and mark BLOCKED.

required_actions: determine whether independent continuation is safe

no_false_success.insufficient_evidence_message: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE — verification required before success can be claimed.

BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.requires: Objective evidence of an external dependency or unavailable capability preventing completion.

BLOCKED.requires: Objective evidence of an unresolved blocker requiring higher-level intervention.

RE-PLAN_REQUIRED.requires: Objective evidence that the current implementation approach is invalid.

live_handover_requirements.rule: A LIVE recovery status must contain real observed values. Template placeholders are permitted only when this protocol is stored as a reusable template rather than executed.

final_supervisor_mandate: Protect verified engineering progress, detect genuine failure rather than mistaking silence for failure, autonomously diagnose root cause, direct the executing developer, execute available verification, correct recoverable problems, re-plan invalid approaches, enforce every invariant, prevent regression, escalate genuine blockers, and drive DIR-021 to objectively verified completion. Do not restart verified work. Do not dump the original specification. Do not fabricate evidence. Do not claim success without evidence. Do not silently substitute baselines. Do not bypass quota or security controls. Do not accept accessibility or performance claims without verification. Do not perform destructive recovery without proof and authorization. Do not repeatedly retry an unchanged failed approach. Recover intelligently. Preserve what is proven. Correct what is broken. Verify everything that matters. Continue autonomously whenever the environment permits it.
